Synopsis:
Cal has been rescued from Moonrise Towers by the player and is now in Last Light. This dialogue covers multiple states: Rolan is missing, Rolan is dead, Rolan and Cal had a fight (player must pass a persuade to calm the fight, pass and fail states here), and a general state for when cal, lia and rolan are all alive and well and cal is grateful to the player.

Cluster Contexts:
- HAV_ProdigyLament_Brother.json: Cal is a tiefling the player recently pulled out of Moonrise Towers and is now recovering in Last Light; the tower raid by Absolute cultists and their guards is the off‑screen cause of his trauma. The dialogue can take one of several emotional states: Rolan may be missing, confirmed dead, or alive but estranged after a bitter fight with Cal. In the fight branch the player can attempt a Persuade to calm them — success soothes tensions, failure leaves anger and accusations unresolved. In the more hopeful branch Cal (with Lia and Rolan) is alive and grateful to the player for rescuing them.
- HAV_ProdigyLament_Sister.json: Lia has been rescued from Moonrise Towers by the player and is now in Last Light. This dialogue covers multiple states: Rolan is missing, Rolan is dead, Rolan and Lia had a fight (player must pass a persuade to calm the fight, pass and fail states here), and a general state for when cal, lia and rolan are all alive and well and Lia is grateful to the player.
- HAV_ProdigyLament_Reunion.json: Cal and/or Lia have been rescued from Moonrise towers and reunited with Rolan in Last Light Inn. It is initially a tense scene - Rolan was worried sick/is angry one of his siblings is dead and is taking it out on his family. It is up to the player to calm them down and remind them of what is important - family.
- HAV_ProdigyLament_AD_BeforeReunion.json: This AD covers the following scenarios: Lia alive, Cal dead. Cal alive, Lia dead. Cal, Lia and Rolan all alive and well. This AD occurs after the player has rescued Cal and/ or Lia from Moonrise towers, but BEFORE the player triggers the reunion scene in Last Light. The siblings are standing together and arguing.
- LOW_SorcerousSundries_Cal.json: Dialog with Cal, who is now working at Sorcerous Sundries, following his brother Rolan, who is now an apprentice there. For her to be there, she needs to have been saved in Act 2.

- Cal: When you told me about Rolan, I didn't believe you. But it's true... || [context] NodeContext: distant voice, he can't believe what he's just learned (node 0)
- Cal: My big brother is dead. || [context] NodeContext: distant voice, he can't believe what he's just learned (node 31)
- Player: He died as he lived - stupidly. (node 21)

context: Cal is a tiefling the player recently pulled out of Moonrise Towers and is now recovering in Last Light after the cultist raid that traumatized him and his family. The scene concerns Cal, his sister Lia (also rescued), and their brother Rolan, whose status varies by playthrough: missing, confirmed dead, or alive but estranged after a bitter fight. In the fight branch the player can attempt a Persuade to calm tensions—success soothes the siblings, failure leaves anger and accusations unresolved. In the hopeful branch all three are reunited and grateful to the player for rescuing them. The dialogue lines reflect grief, disbelief, blame, or relief depending on which of these off‑screen outcomes occurred.
